concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-naverpay-api-only]] — 2026-09-15 NaverPay API-only Advanced-flow add-on for KR/KRW discovery and redirect response, with no NaverPay test environment; item-data/no-extra-parameters and incomplete-payment-example tensions are qualified in the source.
warnings: The page simultaneously says the request includes item details and needs no additional parameters; payment examples omit both item details and explicit paymentMethod, so do not present them as complete validated code.
Adyen Checkout TEST example URLs coexist with a no-NaverPay-test-environment statement; they do not prove a provider sandbox transaction.
RedirectShopper/action.type redirect is an intermediate action, not final authorization, capture or settlement.
